reasoning: The icon combines a telephone receiver with a triangular Wi-Fi sector, the standard glyph for Wi-Fi calling and VoIP/internet calls. It is ideal for tasks specifically about Wi-Fi calling settings, VoIP hardware/software, or internet voice calls, and can double as a general phone call icon, though at tiny sizes the wedge can resemble an incoming-call arrow.
